reviews.text:
Very moisturising leaves your skin glassy for hours.
A little to thick for an ampule perhaps the structure would be better as a cream
reviews.zh:
非常保濕，皮膚可以keep住玻璃肌幾個鐘。
對於安瓶嚟講可能有少少太厚，如果係做cream嘅質地可能會更加好。

reviews.text: This is my second bottle. Amazing ampoule for winter or if you have dry skin. My skin is combination but in winter, this gives me a wonderful glow and moisturizes without leaving me greasy. Just make sure to shake it so that it comes out well, if you don’t, it can feel too thick.
reviews.zh: 呢個已經係我第二枝。冬天用好正，或者如果你係乾性肌都好啱。我係混合性肌，但係冬天用佢就會畀到我好靚嘅光澤，而且保濕得嚟又唔會油笠。記得用之前要搖勻佢，唔係嘅話會覺得太杰身。

reviews.text:
The TIRTIR Ceramic Milk Ampoule has become one of the most talked-about hydrating ampoules in the skincare world, and after using it consistently, I can understand why it has earned such a loyal following. Before anything else, it’s important to clarify that despite the name “milk,” this product is strictly a topical skincare ampoule and is not edible in any way. The “milk” in the name refers to its creamy, nourishing texture and moisture-locking finish—not something meant for consumption. With that said, this ampoule focuses on strengthening the skin barrier, deeply hydrating the skin, and promoting a smooth, luminous complexion.

From the very first application, the texture of the TIRTIR Ceramic Milk Ampoule stands out. It has a silky, lotion-like consistency that spreads easily without feeling heavy. Some ampoules tend to be watery and others too thick, but this product strikes a comfortable balance in between. It melts into the skin, leaving a dewy finish that feels soft rath
reviews.zh:
TIRTIR Ceramic Milk Ampoule 已經成為護膚界其中一款最多人談論的保濕安瓶，持續使用之後，我明白點解佢能夠得到咁忠實嘅追隨者。先講清楚，雖然個名入面有「milk」，但呢個產品純粹係外用嘅護膚安瓶，絕對唔可以食。個名入面嘅「milk」係指佢嗰種 creamy、有營養感嘅質地同鎖水嘅妝效——唔係話可以拎嚟飲嘅。講返呢支安瓶本身，佢主打強化皮膚屏障、深層保濕，以及令膚色變得平滑有光澤。

由第一次用開始，TIRTIR Ceramic Milk Ampoule 嘅質地已經突出晒。佢質地絲滑，似 lotion 咁，好容易推開又唔覺得厚重。有啲安瓶會偏水，有啲就太杰，但呢支就喺中間搵到一個舒服嘅平衡。佢會融入皮膚，留低一個水光妝效，感覺軟…

reviews.text: I think if you have really dry skin this would be great! The applicator is a bit hard to use and the texture is super think. For me I have combination skin and I’ll really only use it at night, but my skin wakes up feeling really moisturized!
reviews.zh: 我覺得如果你真係乾性肌嘅話，呢個會好正！個塗抹器有少少難用，質地超杰。我自己係混合性肌，只會夜晚用，但朝早起身皮膚真係好保濕！

reviews.text: This is like putting milk on your skin, it's so rich and moisturizing and leaves the skin so soft. Plus it's great for my dry and very sensitive skin. I suggest to put a lightweight moisturizer after, otherwise it would feel a little too much heavy.
reviews.zh: 好似將奶搽上皮膚咁，好豐盈又保濕，搽完皮膚好軟。再者，佢好適合我呢種乾性加敏感肌。我建議之後再疊一層薄身嘅保濕霜，否則會覺得稍為厚重咗少少。

reviews.text: Love this ampoule so much! This is the most hydrating and supple ampoule I’ve ever tried and it leave such a beautiful dewy glow. I love using this at night when I need that extra hydration. I will definitely be repurchasing.
reviews.zh: 超鍾意呢支安瓶！佢係我用過最保濕、最有彈性嘅安瓶，用完皮膚帶住好靚嘅水光感。我鍾意夜晚用，等皮膚補多啲水。一定會回購。

reviews.text:
ABSOLUTELY PERFECT 
I bought the full size after trying out the travel version, and I gotta say that that little bottle was such a good investment. I finished it in two three weeks which is pretty fast byy standards.
I cannot stop talking sbout how moisturizing it is, and it smells good? Milky in texture, vanilla-y in scent.
Love it 🫶🏻
reviews.zh:
完美到不行
我試完旅行裝之後就買咗正裝，嗰支細嘅真係超抵玩。我兩三個星期就用完，標準嚟講算快。
我講極都停唔到口——佢有幾保濕，仲有好香？質地似奶，味道有雲呢嗰味。
好愛 🫶🏻

reviews.text: This ampoule is controversial. Not so much suitable for combination or oily skin. This ampoule is oily but for god sake it leaves your skin soooo shiny and you definately reach the glass looking skin. I recommend use it at night when oil absorbed whole. In the morning you will be very supprized what you will see. I do not recommend apply it in morning, probably just during winter time to protect your skin.
reviews.zh: 呢支安瓶好具爭議性。唔算好適合混合性或者油性肌。佢係油嘅，但天呀，用完皮膚會閃到爆，輕鬆達到玻璃肌效果。建議夜晚用，等啲油完全被吸收。朝早起身你就會見到令你好驚喜嘅嘢。唔建議朝早搽，可能冬天先用嚟保護皮膚就好啲。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
